panels.title: Not running
panels.description: Exited, restarting, created, paused or dead containers.

panels.title: Unhealthy
panels.description: Containers whose Docker health check is failing.

panels.title: Restarts (24h)
panels.description: Restarts done by Docker's restart policy (crashes), all containers.

panels.title: Containers CPU share
panels.description: CPU used by all containers, as % of total host CPU.

panels.title: Containers memory share
panels.description: Working set memory of all containers, as % of host RAM.

panels.title: Load (1m / cores)
panels.description: 1m load average per CPU core. Above 100% means work is queuing.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: iowait high = waiting on disk/NFS; steal high = Proxmox is starving the VM.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: Current state of every container. Network columns are empty for containers on the host network (plex, jellyfin, tailscale, ...).

panels.title: Status over time
panels.description: Status from docker_state.sh (every minute). Gaps mean the container didn't exist.

targets.expr: (max by (name) (docker_container_info{name=~"$container",status="running",health="healthy"}) * 3) or (max by (name) (docker_container_info{name=~"$container",status="running",health="none"}) * 2) or (max by (name) (docker_container_info{name=~"$container",status="running",health="starting"}) * 1) or (max by (name) (docker_container_info{name=~"$container",status="running",health="unhealthy"}) * 0) or (max by (name) (docker_container_info{name=~"$container",status!="running"}) * -1)

panels.title: Memory (working set)
panels.description: Memory the kernel can't reclaim. This is what counts for OOM kills.

panels.title: Network in
panels.description: Containers on the host network (plex, jellyfin, tailscale, ...) aren't shown; see Host network.

panels.title: Network out
panels.description: Containers on the host network (plex, jellyfin, tailscale, ...) aren't shown; see Host network.

panels.title: Restarts
panels.description: Crash restarts done by Docker's restart policy.
